name: Car seat installation
summary: How expat parents get car seats installed correctly in Singapore — ISOFIX vs belt-fit checks, Grab/private hire realities, and installer vs self-fit trade-offs.
body:
Correct car seat installation prevents the most common misuse errors: loose base, wrong recline, and twisted belts. Singapore cars mix ISOFIX and belt-only anchors; private-hire vehicles may refuse certain rear-facing setups.

## Typical jobs
- ISOFIX base fit checks on family cars
- Belt-threaded infant seats without ISOFIX
- Second-car / helper-driver seat transfers
- Expiry and crash-replacement advice
- Travel seat strategies for grandparents visiting

Always follow the seat manual for that exact model.

## How to choose
Prefer installers who demonstrate the 1-inch wiggle test and show tether routing. Ask whether they install in HDB / condo carparks. Confirm they will not sell you a seat that does not fit your vehicle’s anchors.

## Practical tip
Photograph the installed seat’s labels and path of the seatbelt. Re-checks after a long Grab week catch creeping looseness early.
